localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch-born 19-year-old men were on average 182.9 cm tall in 2020 (women 169.3 cm), so the post's 6 ft (183 cm) threshold is the average young Dutch man.
Rijksmuseum: photographing and filming is allowed without disturbing others; for bridal shoots "geen statieven en geen extra belichting".
Local terms: haakse zoeker (right-angle viewfinder), klapscherm/kantelscherm, middenkolom, monopod/eenpootstatief, krukje, kniebeschermer.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall gear that is also light is hard to find (Tweakers, 1.96 m photographer looking for a monopod).
localPainPoints.fix: Check the monopod's maximum height before the head (about 178-183 cm / 70-72 in); a 192 cm Gitzo with four of five sections reaches chin height for a 1.86 m owner.

quotes.text: Maar nu zijn er weinig monopods die lang en licht zijn.

localPainPoints.pain: Some Dutch forum members would rather bend or kneel than carry an unwieldy, expensive tall tripod.
localPainPoints.fix: The post's stool/knee-pad + mid-size tripod route (Dave's bundle), and a tilting screen so you look down instead of bending.

quotes.text: Vaak kun je dus beter een stukje bukken of door je knieen dan een onhandelbaar en duur statief mee te sjouwen.

localGain.point: CBS average height 182.9 cm: in the Netherlands the 'tall photographer' is the average young man.
